feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 13 November 2026 4:00pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 13 November 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure covers the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

West, backing southwest, 3 or 4, gradually increasing south or southwest 5 or 6 overnight and tomorrow morning. Perhaps touching 7 in the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming mainly moderate tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, perhaps moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6 occasionally 7, soon increasing 6 or 7 for a time, though a force lower in the southeast of the area. Then decreasing 4 or 5 for a time Sunday morning, before veering northwest 6 to gale 8 Sunday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, decreasing mainly moderate for a time Sunday morning.


##Weather##

Occasional rain.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.
